interface.shortDescription: Embedded project console and local graphs
interface.longDescription:
Version 0.6.0. Operator is the Codex plugin for Agent Operator Kit: a human-supervised cockpit for real projects with an MCP-powered console that can render directly in compatible Codex Desktop conversations. The console reads project configuration, lanes, feature sessions, dependency graphs, conflicts, and runnable work without changing project state.

Use it to coordinate feature chats, isolated worktrees, reusable lane roles, task packets, handoffs, memory, roadmap items, feedback intake, planning, design review, UX audits, journeys, and incubation. Execution remains explicit: the embedded console can send a user-selected planning or status request into the conversation, while dispatch, collect, merge, and cleanup continue through reviewed Operator workflows.
